about: DESIGN_SYSTEMS_CONFIG_DIR values and the folder each must resolve to, run by tools/test_routes.py (server/provider_store.py) and web/lib/provider-api.test.ts (web/lib/provider-store.ts) so both stores name the same provider.db. <HOME> is the test's home folder (a real path, no links in it), <REPO> the checkout, <REPO_SWAPCASE> the checkout with the letter case of its last part swapped, <LINK> a symlink the test makes that points at the checkout, <OUT_LINK> a symlink the test makes that points at <HOME>/outside, and <DB_LINK_DIR>, <JOURNAL_LINK_DIR> and <LOCK_LINK_DIR> folders the test makes where provider.db, provider.db-journal or provider.lock is a symlink to a file outside them. "error" means the store refuses the value as a folder; "error-link" means it refuses it because a store file is a symbolic link. "error-if-case-insensitive" means refused where the filesystem ignores case and resolved as typed elsewhere. A folder that resolves is returned with the links in its existing part resolved, so "<OUT_LINK>/cfg" is <HOME>/outside/cfg.
